name: family-hub
description: Family Hub — plateforme familiale modulaire à base de tuiles

scripts.build:design: npm run build --workspace=@family-hub/design && node packages/design/scripts/gen-hub-css.mjs && node packages/design/scripts/gen-display-css.mjs && node packages/design/scripts/copy-display-fonts.mjs
scripts.check:display: node scripts/check-display-es5.mjs && node scripts/check-display-css.mjs && node scripts/check-display-assets.mjs
scripts.build: npm run check:display && npm run build:design && npm run build:types && npm run build:controle-parental && npm run build:functions && npm run build:hub
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run check:display && npm run build:design && npm run build:types && npm run build:controle-parental && npm run build:hub && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
